extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology record from XML results, figure captions, methods, and supplementary DOCX.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Both peptides have source-supported bacterial membrane-disruption evidence from outer-membrane NPN uptake, cytoplasmic membrane depolarization, and FE-SEM morphology assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Exact fluorescence and image-derived magnitudes are not tabulated in local material; mechanism conclusion is qualitative but directly assayed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Ak-N’m has source-supported anti-inflammatory pathway evidence in LPS-stimulated THP-1-derived macrophages, including TLR4/CD14 antibody-blocking comparison and reduced cytokine readouts.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The source supports pathway interaction/comparison, not a purified biophysical binding constant.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Ak-N’m is reported to attenuate MyD88/MAPK/NF-κB and TRIF/IRF3 pathway readouts after LPS stimulation.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No nucleic-acid binding mechanism is claimed; prior automated nucleic-acid note was removed as unsupported.
